title: BanglaFactBenchClaimRecord
description: Standardized schema for atomic claim records in BanglaFactBench

claim_id.description: Unique identifier for the claim (e.g., BFB-CLM-0001)

claim_text_bn.description: The verbatim claim text in original Bengali or Romanized Banglish

claim_text_normalized.description: Unicode NFC-normalized claim text with standardized punctuation and whitespaces

source_type.description: Type of digital medium where the claim originated

source_name.description: Name of the publisher, platform, or fact-checking organization

source_url.description: URL of the primary source or fact-check archive

publication_date.description: Date of publication or fact-check report (YYYY-MM-DD)

claim_date.description: Estimated date the claim began circulating (YYYY-MM-DD)

language.description: Primary language of the claim text

language_variant.description: Linguistic style or script representation of the claim

speaker_or_author_if_public.description: Name of public figure or official institution claiming the statement (redacted if private individual)

context.description: Concise background context necessary to interpret the claim

evidence_urls.description: List of authoritative reference URLs corroborating or refuting the claim

evidence_text.description: Excerpts of verified factual evidence directly supporting or refuting the claim

confidence.description: Annotator consensus or evidence certainty score

annotation_notes.description: Justification notes explaining the rationale for label assignment

adjudicated_label.description: Final resolved label assigned following expert adjudication
